what: Media files of the Nagi Burst V2 page (site/burst-v2/): hero loop and posters, highlights clip and poster, social card and its frame. Every file is re-encoded or composed from an existing replay render; nothing plays a model.

highlights_verification.clip: ~/Downloads/Nagi-Burst-V2-Arena/social/Nagi-Burst-V2_3-3-3_raw_16x9_1920x1080.mp4 (raw full rounds, 1x, back to back, 0.5 s hold on each final frame; 418.57 s, 12,557 frames)
highlights_verification.stated_rule: per game, the 24 sealed eval indices ordered by V2 score descending, ties -> larger V2 - V1 margin -> lowest index; walk the order and keep the first 3 that pass every replay/score check for every seat (RR: plus the per-seat state-hash drift check in the bv2n-rr:py31112-np246 linux/amd64 image). Skipped: Rotorwash-Ramp #42 (Nagi Burst V1 seat not hash-exact over its flight on the render platform, first mismatch tick 101 <= end tick 117).
highlights_verification.recomputed_from: bench/burst_v2/receipts/arena_v2.json out_order (sealed eval split, 24 indices per game; snake 10-33, rotorwash_ramp 34-57, booster_gauntlet 34-57)
highlights_verification.seeds_on_screen_method: the per-round 'sealed seed #N' label read from frames at 3, 25.5, 48, 70.5, 131, 189, 239.75, 300.25, 360.75 s; final live scores read at round ends (booster #34 V2 1.00; rr #35 V2 1.15 / V1 0.50; snake #29 V2 60.0 s / V1 11.5 s) equal arena_v2.json
highlights_verification.verdict: The shown seeds equal the rule's output. 'Best 3 of 24 sealed seeds per game' holds only in the sense 'highest V2 score': every shown seed's V2 score is >= every unshown seed's V2 score in all three games. It is not a unique top 3: Booster Gauntlet has 23 seeds tied at V2 1.00 (V1 0.00 on all, so the lowest indices 34-36 are shown); Snake Rush has 8 seeds tied at the 60 s cap (ties broken by V2 - V1 margin); on Rotorwash-Ramp #42 (V2 1.10) ranks second by the rule but was skipped for replay drift, so #56 and #45 (also 1.10) are shown. The selection favours V2 by construction; these are not typical rounds (the page's median-margin clips are).
highlights_verification.label_exact: Highlights: V2's best 3 of 24 sealed seeds per game, by V2 score (ties: larger V2-V1 margin, then lowest seed; Rotorwash-Ramp #42 skipped for replay drift). Same seeds for all three seats.
highlights_verification.label_short: Highlights: best 3 of 24 sealed seeds per game by V2 score (picked for V2, not typical)

files.role: hero autoplay loop (muted, no audio track), 4:5
files.seed_rule: median V2-Jev margin (bench/burst_v2/receipts/arena_v2_videos.json seed_rule; same clip as the page's Game Arena section)

range.continuity: one continuous, uncut segment of one real round from the raw 1x render (arena_v2_videos.json playback 'raw 1x, no edits'): on-screen game clock = frame/30 s (read at frames 0, 45, 300, 330, 345, 360 -> 0.0, 1.5, 10.0, 11.0, 11.5, 12.0 s); ffmpeg freezedetect (n=0.0005, d=0.2) finds no frozen span in the cropped segment.
range.why_this_window: all three rockets descending at the same seed, V2 lowest and closing on the deck; it ends before the first in-scene status text about another seat (Jev 'LOW FUEL' tag from about 12.5 s; 'Jev OUT' banner and V2 touchdown at 15.8 s are outside the loop).
range.crop_in_source: 768x960 at x=156, y=380 of 1080x1920 (sky, three rockets with their seat tags, ship, sea; the HUD, seat chips, header line with scores and the AI BRAINS table are outside the crop)
range.edits: 0.3 s fade-in from black and 0.4 s fade-out to black at the loop seam only

files.cmd: ffmpeg -i site/arena/media/v2-BoosterGauntlet-V2-V1-Jev-seed34.mp4 -an -vf "trim=start_frame=90:end_frame=360,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS,crop=768:960:156:380,scale=720:900:flags=lanczos,fade=t=in:st=0:d=0.3,fade=t=out:st=8.6:d=0.4,format=yuv420p" -c:v libx264 -preset veryslow -tune animation -crf 20 -profile:v high -movflags +faststart -fflags +bitexact -flags +bitexact site/burst-v2/media/hero-loop.mp4

files.role: hero poster (WebP, smaller than the JPEG)
highlights clip: 9 raw full rounds (3 per game) back to back, three seats on the same sealed seed, 1x
files.label: Highlights: V2's best 3 of 24 sealed seeds per game, by V2 score (ties: larger V2-V1 margin, then lowest seed; Rotorwash-Ramp #42 skipped for replay drift). Same seeds for all three seats.
files.label_short: Highlights: best 3 of 24 sealed seeds per game by V2 score (picked for V2, not typical)
files.seed_rule: best by V2 score; see highlights_verification

range.note: whole clip, re-encoded only (no cuts); the burned-in footer reads 'Best 3 of 24 sealed seeds per game · same seeds for all three · V2: offline 1-tick replies; V1, Jev: live records'

files.cmd: ffmpeg -i SRC -an -vf "scale=1280:720:flags=lanczos,format=yuv420p" -c:v libx264 -preset slow -tune animation -b:v 110k -maxrate 450k -bufsize 900k -g 300 -pass 1 -f mp4 /dev/null && ffmpeg -i SRC -vf "scale=1280:720:flags=lanczos,format=yuv420p" -c:v libx264 -preset slow -tune animation -b:v 110k -maxrate 450k -bufsize 900k -g 300 -pass 2 -profile:v high -c:a aac -b:a 32k -ac 1 -movflags +faststart -fflags +bitexact -flags +bitexact site/burst-v2/media/highlights-3-3-3.mp4  (SRC = the source above)
files.notes: 1280x720 chosen over 1920x1080 for the 8 MB budget (418.6 s => ~150 kbps total); round labels, live scores and seat names checked readable at 720p on Booster, Rotorwash-Ramp and Snake frames. Audio kept as AAC-LC 32 kbps mono.

files.role: highlights poster: round 1 (Booster Gauntlet sealed seed #34), three rockets descending, round label and seat panel visible
game frame used by the social card (input of make_og.py)
files.cmd: python3 site/burst-v2/build/make_og.py frame  (= ffmpeg -i site/arena/media/v2-BoosterGauntlet-V2-V1-Jev-seed34.mp4 -frames:v 1 -fps_mode passthrough -vf "select=eq(n\,300),crop=662:948:209:381,scale=440:630:flags=lanczos" -q:v 2 -fflags +bitexact -flags +bitexact site/burst-v2/media/og-frame.jpg; the source sha256 is pinned in make_og.py)

python3 site/burst-v2/build/make_og.py   (check: python3 site/burst-v2/build/make_og.py check -> rebuilds in a temp dir and compares sha256; deterministic for this ffmpeg build and these macOS fonts: Impact, Arial Bold, Arial, Menlo)
files.notes: Card text: title 'NAGI BURST V2', subtitle 'Write the rules.' / 'Get the decision.', four stats whose numbers are read by make_og.py from data.json values: UNSEEN MACHINES g_theta (success, g_families unseen families); ARENA VS NAGI BURST V1 a_snake_W · a_rotorwash_W · a_booster_W (win share, Snake · Rotorwash · Booster); LEARNED CORE core_params (parameters, numpy only); DECISION LATENCY '≤ ' + l_max_ucb (largest p95 upper bound, one CPU thread); eyebrow 'NAGI SDK ' + sdk_tag. Labels are prose with no measured number. Game panel = og-frame.jpg (all three seats, seat tags only, no scores).
